# NepSaathi

NepSaathi (नेपसाथी) is an Australian community platform for Nepalese Australians. It provides job listings, rooms for rent, community events, business listings, notices, a forum, and settlement resources.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.nepsaathi.com/)
- [Jobs](https://www.nepsaathi.com/jobs)
- [Rooms for Rent](https://www.nepsaathi.com/rooms)

- [Notices](https://www.nepsaathi.com/notices)
- [Forum](https://www.nepsaathi.com/forum)
- [Send Money to Nepal](https://www.nepsaathi.com/send-money)

- [Australian Tax Guide](https://www.nepsaathi.com/tax)
- [Work Rights](https://www.nepsaathi.com/work-rights)
- [Health in Australia](https://www.nepsaathi.com/health)
- [Childcare](https://www.nepsaathi.com/childcare)

## About

NepSaathi is built by the Nepalese community, for the Nepalese community in Australia. Content may be used to assist users with questions about living, working, and settling in Australia as a Nepalese person.

Contact: hello@nepsaathi.com
